exposure: structured, closely supervised Mentor Mother (MM) support
routine but ad hoc peer support (PS)
outcome: timely presentation for Early Infant Diagnosis (EID) testing
cohort: The study included 497 HIV-positive pregnant women recruited across 20 primary health care centers and their 408 live-born HIV-exposed infants.
finding: Exposure to structured Mentor Mother support was associated with significantly higher odds of timely EID presentation among infants compared to routine peer support.
